title: persica vulgaris f. sanguinea
intro: Persica vulgaris f. sanguinea, commonly known as Persian plum or Sanguine plum, is a variety of the Prunus persica plant. It is a deciduous tree native to Central Asia and China, known for its vibrant red or purple flowers and edible fruit. The health benefits of Persica vulgaris f. sanguinea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues and relieve stress, due in part to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
